name: Awwwards
summary: Award platform and showcase of outstanding web design: Sites of the Day, curated collections and an Elements library.
description: Awwwards recognizes outstanding web design and shows it off: browse Site of the Day/Month/Year winners and nominees by category (portfolios, e-commerce, architecture, fashion, mobile apps …), or dig into the Elements gallery of UI examples — menus, forms, footers, hero sections and scroll transitions. Curated Collections and a directory of agencies and professionals support the awards; a public read-only API serves Annual Awards data.
contains: Sites of the Day/Month/Year with jury scores
Elements gallery: 100s of form, footer, menu, transition and hero examples
